questions.question: An expert in the law asked Jesus how to inherit eternal life. Which two commands did the expert name from the Law?

answers.text: Loving God and loving your neighbor
Keeping the Sabbath and giving offerings
Honoring parents and telling the truth

questions.question: In Jesus' story of a man beaten by robbers, what did the priest do when he saw the man?

answers.text: He passed by on the other side
He ran to the next town for help
He stopped and spoke with the robbers

questions.question: In Jesus' story of a man beaten by robbers, how did the Samaritan help the hurt man on the road?

answers.text: He went to him and bandaged his wounds
He called out for anyone nearby to help
He gave him his cloak and kept going

questions.question: After Jesus told the story of a beaten man, which of the three men did the expert in the law say was a neighbor?

answers.text: The one who showed him mercy
